title: From rice field to plate
text:
Rice is an important food in Indonesia. Many families eat it every day. But how does rice grow?

First, farmers grow young rice plants from seeds. Then they plant the young plants in a wet field called a sawah. The field needs lots of water.

The rice plants grow tall and green. After three or four months, grains of rice grow at the top of each plant. The plants turn yellow. This shows that the rice is ready.

Farmers cut the plants and shake out the grains. The grains are dried in the sun. Then a machine takes off the hard outside part, called the husk.

Now the rice is ready to cook and eat!
